FR-002.title: Users can organise components through Salt-native layout structures

FR-003.title: Users can configure supported UI components without writing Salt syntax

FR-005.title: Users can inspect the actual PlantUML output of screens and the screen flow

FR-007.title: Users can reverse and restore editing operations

FR-008.title: The application supports non-technical users with clear guidance and feedback

FR-012.title: Users can build and edit a screen flow without writing activity syntax

FR-013.title: Users can link flow steps to screens and navigate between them

FR-014.title: Users can download, export images and copy source

FR-015.title: Users can see and move between all parts of a project

FR-016.title: The workspace brings every editing region together

FR-017.title: All rendering happens inside the user browser

FR-018.title: The application works offline after one visit

FR-019.title: Unsupported browsers are detected and reported

SC-008.title: No diagram content over the network; works offline

intent: Let non-technical users build PlantUML Salt wireframes and linked screen flows visually, stored locally and exchanged as one standard .puml file without losing user work
expectations: Freeform pixel positioning or high-fidelity styling
Server-side rendering or sending diagram content off the browser
More than one screen flow per project
Visual editing of fork/join, switch, partitions, detach/kill
Label formatting beyond the selected tab
Browsers other than Chromium-based desktop browsers
context: PlantUML 1.2026.8 command-line verification of supported constructs

decisions.decision: Source text is the only truth; lossless hand-written parsers derive the model and every visual edit is a text patch plus re-parse
decisions.why: Byte-identical round trips, grammar-based status and undo then share one mechanism (FR-004, FR-020, SC-005)
decisions.rejected: Model-first regeneration of source, or a parser generator

decisions.decision: Render with @plantuml/core 1.2026.9 in a dedicated Web Worker; terminate and restart it after 10 s
decisions.why: Official browser build with Salt (OD-1); renderToString cannot be cancelled; worker loaders refuse includes

decisions.decision: TypeScript, Vite, React 19 static site with a small useSyncExternalStore store
decisions.why: Static offline deployment and mature accessibility testing tools
decisions.rejected: Svelte or Lit; Redux or Zustand

decisions.decision: IndexedDB via idb with one atomic record per project; Web Locks plus BroadcastChannel for one editing tab
decisions.why: Atomic writes and locks that are released when a tab crashes
decisions.rejected: localStorage; a heartbeat lock in storage

decisions.decision: CodeMirror 6 source view, dnd-kit drag with activation constraints, DOMPurify sanitising, Workbox precache
decisions.why: Accessible editor, touch-safe dragging, maintained sanitiser, full offline precache
decisions.rejected: Monaco; native HTML drag and drop; runtime-only caching

decisions.decision: Block status is derived from category, focus and render result, never stored
decisions.why: Removes status drift; only the last working version and the flow identity are stored

decisions.decision: Verification commands left as None until the setup task adds package scripts
decisions.why: The integrated TDD rules take commands only from what the project defines
decisions.rejected: Declaring planned commands that do not exist yet

decisions.decision: A flow with lanes writes its first |Lane| switch before start
decisions.why: PlantUML 1.2026.9 rejects a lane switch that follows any statement unless a lane was declared first
decisions.rejected: Assigning pre-lane elements to the first lane without writing a switch before start

decisions.decision: A first |Lane| after any statement is a syntax error (diagnostic.syntax.laneNotFirst)
decisions.why: plantuml-1.2026.9.jar rejects it deterministically; the parser had assumed such elements go in the first lane
decisions.rejected: Assigning pre-lane elements to the first lane

decisions.decision: History entries hold a list of {edits, inverse} changes rather than one edits/inverse pair
decisions.why: A merged typing run is several applied edit lists; composing them into one list is error-prone

decisions.decision: Draw nested Salt containers recursively inside their cell
decisions.why: The canvas showed a dashed placeholder, so a Form or Group box could not be edited visually
decisions.rejected: Enter-to-descend navigation that shows one container at a time

decisions.decision: Hand commands and the preview handler the live store through a banner bridge in flow-links/register.tsx
decisions.why: Slot commands are plain functions, not hooks, and the ESLint react-hooks rule forbids reassigning module state during render

plan.summary: Plan, research (R-1 to R-15), data model, 3 contracts, Verification Plan with 137 obligations, 5 manual checks, 1 exemption and 143 behaviour items; TDD plan check passes in no-tooling mode

approach: Source text is authoritative: lossless hand-written Salt and activity parsers derive the editor model, and every visual operation is a minimal text patch followed by a re-parse, so round trips, status and undo share one path. A static TypeScript, Vite and React app stores projects in IndexedDB and renders with @plantuml/core 1.2026.9 in a terminable Web Worker, precached for offline use.
